name: Stingy
overview: Scripture warns against stinginess by contrasting it with generosity, showing that withholding more than is appropriate leads to poverty, while a liberal and compassionate heart is richly blessed. Those who give to the poor are seen as lending to the Lord Himself, who will repay their kindness. The desire to quickly gain wealth and the accompanying stinginess are described as having an 'evil eye,' which ultimately results in loss. Thus, God calls His people to embrace generosity and resist the temptation to hoard, trusting in His provision and blessing.
